learning_outcomes.text: Can perform force/power calculations for plastic forming and determine the necessary properties of the material to be shaped.
Can select appropriate independent variables such as material structure, temperature, and strain rate for manufacturing.
Can design the processing steps and conditions for defect-free manufacturing.
Can identify plastic forming manufacturing defects and suggest solutions.

syllabus_topics: Metallurgical Principles and Variables Affecting Plastic Forming
Variables Affecting Plastic Forming and Assignment 1 evaluations
Wire, Rod and Tube Drawing and Cutting
assessment_rules: The overall assessment is based on 50% from in-term work and 50% from the final exam. In-term work includes Assignment 1 (20%), Midterm Exam (50%), and Assignment 2 (30%).
bibliography: Levon ÇAPAN, Metallere Plastik Şekil Verme, Çağlayan Kitabevi, İstanbul, 2010
E. Sabri KAYALI, Cahit ENSARİ, Metallere Plastik Şekil Verme İlke ve Uygulamaları, İ.T.Ü. Kimya – Metalurji Fakültesi Ofset Atölyesi, İstanbul, 1991.
